# Bundled Photography Provenance

All photographs below were individually checked on their WordPress Photo Directory detail pages on 2026-08-08. Each detail page identifies the contributor and states that the original content was submitted under the CC0 1.0 public-domain dedication. The optimized local WebP files were created from the listed WordPress Photo Directory derivatives and are never hotlinked at runtime.

License for every item: **CC0 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0) Public Domain Dedication**  
License URL: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/  
Source website: https://wordpress.org/photos/
